faq.question: What does the program include?

faq.question: How does the application process work?
faq.answer: Apply using the form on this page. Our team reviews each application and typically responds within a few business days. If you qualify, we'll confirm and apply your credits to your account.

faq.question: How long are the credits valid?

faq.question: Can I apply if I'm already using OptiTech?

faq.question: What happens when my credits run out or expire?

hero.title: OptiTech's Security & Compliance
hero.subtitle: At OptiTech, security, compliance, privacy, and transparency are core to our platform. We protect customer data through industry leading security controls, independent audits, and strict adherence to global compliance standards.

soc2.title: SOC 2 Type II
soc2.description: OptiTech undergoes annual SOC 2 Type II audits performed by accredited independent third party auditors. The SOC 3 report, a public summary of our SOC 2 compliance, is available without an NDA in the Trust Center.

iso.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 & ISO/IEC 27701:2019
iso.description: OptiTech undergoes annual ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27701:2019 audits for its security and privacy management systems. These certifications validate our commitment to global standards.

dataHosting.title: Data Hosting
dataHosting.description: OptiTech's infrastructure runs on AWS and Azure in EU and Sweden regions, certified for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and other global security standards.

dataSegregation.title: Data Segregation
dataSegregation.description: Customer data is isolated with unique IDs to prevent unauthorized access. The API enforces this through authentication in access tokens.

physicalSecurity.title: Physical & Environmental Security
physicalSecurity.description: OptiTech personnel have no physical access to AWS or Azure data centers, which have 24/7 surveillance, biometric controls, redundancy, and audits.

accessControl.title: Access Control
accessControl.description: Production access is restricted by default, granted only when needed with least-privilege, time-limited permissions via Teleport and approval.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: OptiTech uses Grafana to monitor cloud operations. System failures trigger alerts, notifying key personnel for immediate response and resolution.

vendorRisk.title: Vendor Risk Management
vendorRisk.description: All vendors are assessed for security, privacy, and compliance. Those handling sensitive data must meet SOC 2.

vulnerabilityScanning.title: Network Vulnerability Scanning
vulnerabilityScanning.description: OptiTech performs continuous vulnerability scans on all infrastructure components. Identified vulnerabilities are triaged and remediated based on severity.

intrusionDetection.title: Intrusion Detection & Prevention

logicalAccess.title: Logical Access Controls

incidentResponse.title: Security Incident Response
incidentResponse.description: OptiTech has a 24/7 incident response team following well-defined playbooks, including continuous training and annual tabletop exercises.

scenarios.title: When the clock is already running

items.title: Outside office hours
items.question: An incident is detected outside office hours. Who starts the clock, and when?
items.answer: The clock starts at awareness, not at the next working day. The system alerts the on-call contact, opens a timestamped case, and counts down toward the 24-hour window.

items.title: Reporting order
items.question: You know you must report, but not in which order: CERT-SE, the sector authority, IMY?
items.answer: The system determines recipients and order from entity type, sector, and whether personal data is affected. One incident can open several parallel tracks, each with its own deadline.

items.title: Personal data breach
items.question: A personal data breach occurs. Must it be reported, and within what time?
items.answer: Only breaches that pose a risk to individuals' rights and freedoms are reported to IMY, within 72 hours of discovery. When you decide not to report, the system documents that assessment too.

items.title: Board evidence
items.question: The board asks for status. Is there auditable evidence, as Article 20 requires?
items.answer: Every step is logged with a timestamp, an owner, and a decision. Management gets an auditable record that demonstrates active governance, exactly what Article 20 asks for.

items.name: GDPR / IMY
items.recipient: IMY, when individuals' rights are at risk

items.question: Who must report under NIS2?
items.answer: The duty follows from entity type, essential or important under the Swedish Cybersecurity Act, not from company size in general. The scoping in the platform shows which category you belong to and which windows apply to you.

items.question: Must every personal data breach be reported to IMY?
items.answer: No. Only breaches that pose a risk to data subjects' rights and freedoms must be reported, within 72 hours of discovery. The decision not to report must be documented too, and the system does that automatically.

items.question: What counts as an 'early warning' within 24 hours?
items.answer: A first message to CERT-SE/MSB that a significant incident is under way, not a complete investigation. Among other things, it states whether the incident is suspected to be caused by unlawful acts and whether it may have cross-border effects.

items.question: Who is Sweden's contact point for NIS2?
items.answer: MSB, with CERT-SE as the CSIRT function. Supervision is distributed by sector to authorities such as PTS and the Swedish Energy Markets Inspectorate, depending on your industry.

yazan.label: Founder & CEO
yazan.name: Yazan Ghayad
bio: Yazan founded OptiTech in 2024 and leads the company from Stockholm. He works hands-on across the product: IT services, cloud, infrastructure, and the AI and data analytics the platform is built on.

He is an economist by training, with a degree from Lund University, and OptiTech is not his first company. He previously built Prakto, a digital internship platform that connects students, schools, and companies across Sweden for LIA, APL, VFU, and prao placements, and Sweo. Alongside OptiTech, he works with business development at the Department of Economics at Södertörn University.

His main interests are public finance and public economics: how automation affects productivity, income distribution, and the ability of states to fund welfare systems over time. Moving between theory and practice shapes how he builds OptiTech.
